steps.message: Dos chamados criados em agosto de 2026 na praça Natal pelo analista André Brito, quantos ainda estão em atendimento?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito')) AND status = 'Em atendimento';

SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito')) AND status = 'Em atendimento' ORDER BY ticket;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito')) AND status = 'Concluído';
